title: Polynomial reductions to an oracle class
statement: Let $L$ and $O$ be languages over the binary alphabet. If $L$ is polynomial-time many-one reducible to $O$, then $L$ is decidable in polynomial time by a Turing machine with oracle access to $O$.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ and $O$ are languages over the binary alphabet
